## What's new

- Added a new button to paste osu! timing points from the clipboard, with the option to overwrite or merge with existing timings.
  - You can also drag and drop .osu, .txt, .zip or .osz files onto the timing screen as well.
- Improved the chart preview
  - Added invisible & flying notes
  - Holds that you must spam now have a pink color, while normal holds stay blue
  - (This is useful to tell cop holds and spams apart)
- Added experimental option to have key-charting place UNANIMATED notes without holding shift.
- Importing maps will now attempt to assign the correct difficulty slot to them
- Correctly added the icons for Setpiece and Friend note
- Fixed placement order changes because of time mismatches

**Happy mapping!**
